newsitem.title: UK: UK welfare state needs reform to cut jobless-Brown.
newsitem.headline: UK welfare state needs reform to cut jobless-Brown.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown said on Wednesday the UK's welfare state needed to be reformed to cut unemployment and create great new jobs.

"We have got to do more to create employment opportunity. We will have to reform the welfare state to do that in Britain, and we are going to have to have the labour market flexibility that results from people having skills, and therefore able to move between jobs when jobs become available," he told BBC radio.

"I'm sayng we are going to have to make changes in Britain, but at the same time I think the mesage I'm taking (to Europe) about an action to cut unemployment...will find an echo in many capitals in Europe," Brown added.
He was speaking after he announced a new British initiative to create jobs in the European Union which would be presented to a meeting of EU finance ministers next Monday.
